title: Cursed Coin
description:
A cursed item of unknown purpose.
Rarely dropped by zombies and skeletons.
Use it… if you dare.
body:
**Cursed Coin** is a lightweight standalone artifact mod that adds a mysterious, cursed item to the game.

This coin has no clear origin or purpose. When activated, it emits a dark ambient sound — a disturbing effect that offers no benefit and leaves only questions. It serves no practical use… yet remains undeniably present.

Players may obtain the coin as a rare drop from zombies and skeletons, with skeletons appearing slightly more likely to yield it.

The Cursed Coin is designed to fit seamlessly into survival, dark fantasy, or horror-themed modpacks. It adds subtle atmosphere and unease without affecting balance or progression.

📦 **Features:**
_Unique cursed item with dark ambient sound when used_

_Activates on right-click_

_Rare drop from zombies and skeletons (skeletons slightly more likely)_

_Adds atmosphere without gameplay disruption_

_Fully standalone and compatible with any modpack_

_No dependencies_

**Use it... if you dare.**

**Enter the Forge.** 🕯 https://discord.gg/2ba7qJCkR5
